generator_approval_id_collision.description: In generate_unseen_dataset(), approvals were assigned IDs using randint(10000, 99999). By the birthday paradox, across 1,050 generated approvals, 4 collisions occurred. When the second approval with the same ID was registered in approvals_map, it overwrote the first approval's subject, causing the first event's validation to fail with a Subject Mismatch.

unscoped_session_identifier.description: In evaluate_events(), session states were keyed solely by session_id without actor context. When a random session token (sess-981391) was reused by a benign user 3,000 events later, the engine inherited the 'has_unexpected_role_change' flag from the earlier user's session.
unscoped_session_identifier.fix: Keyed session tracking by (evt.actor, evt.session_id), isolating session state by actor identity.
